Default.inAMomentTell: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play Frantic!
Default.whoNeedsTutorialQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.tut1Text: Each round, one player is the guesser. Everyone else secretly gets the same word and races to draw it on their own whiteboard before the timer runs out.
Default.tut2Header: Drawings are revealed one at a time
Default.tut2Text: The guesser is shown the drawings one by one and says out loud what they think the word is. Each drawing that pops up is a fresh clue!
Default.tut3Text: The sooner the guesser gets it, the more points they score - and the player whose drawing cracked it earns a bonus. So draw clearly and fast!
Default.tut4Text: As drawings appear and the guesser shouts out answers, the host taps Correct! the moment they get it (honor system). At the end, everyone sees all the drawings side by side.
Default.youAreGuesser: You're the guesser this round! Everyone else is drawing the same secret word. Watch the drawings and shout out your guess!
Default.gotYourDrawing: Nice! Sit tight while everyone else finishes drawing.
Default.sitTightGuesser: Others are drawing... get ready to guess!
Default.reviewSelect: Everyone's drawings for "($1)"! ($2), click any drawing to continue.
Default.judgeQuestion: Has ($1) correctly guessed what this drawing is yet?
Default.finalJudgeQuestion: Has ($1) correctly guessed what any of these drawings are yet?
Default.nobodyGotItText: The word was ($1). Better luck next round!
Default.reviewText: Take a look at everyone's drawing for "($1)"!
